## Page 3

Employee Notice Period Policy Doc ID: WIN-HR-POL-007 | Version: 1.5 Policy Summary Our notice period policy ensures smooth transitions for all employees at Wingify Software Private Limited. Effective April 1, 2021, this policy outlines various aspects:

It defines the duration of notice and payout options if notice cannot be served and applies to all current and future full-time employees. During the notice period, employees are expected to fulfill offboarding duties, return company property, and adhere to leave protocols.

Deductions from Full & Final Salary may include laptop and asset values, loan adjustments, taxes, WFH allowance recovery, excess leaves, short notice periods, joining bonus recovery, and EPF/VPF deductions.

Notice periods vary based on Wingify levels and grades, with Grade A&B having a maximum duration of 90 days, Grade C having 60 days, and Grade D & E having 30 days.

This policy aims to ensure clarity, consistency, and fairness in handling notice periods across different circumstances, facilitating smooth transitions for all employees.

## Page 4

## 1. Purpose Our notice period policy is designed to ensure smooth transitions, whether you're moving on or experiencing changes within the organization. It outlines the expected duration an employee must continue working after indicating their intention to leave, facilitating a proper handover of tasks and knowledge transfer. The primary goal is to provide clear guidance on the notice period's maximum duration and outline the payout options available if the notice period cannot be fully served. This approach promotes transparency and fairness in our employment practices, supporting effective planning and seamless transitions for both the departing employees and the company.

## 2. Applicability The policy applies to all Permanent Employees, Interns & Contractors of Wingify Software Private Limited.

## 3. Policy Our Notice Period Policy defines the requirements and expectations for employees serving their notice period in situations such as resignation, dismissal, redundancy, or retirement.

Effective April 1, 2021, this policy provides clear guidelines to ensure consistency, professionalism, and smooth transitions in all cases involving employee departures.

### 3.1 Notice Periods Duration Wingify has defined a notice period duration for employees as per Wingify levels and grades framework; refer to the table below:

| Level & Grade | Group Category | Maximum Duration Confirmed | Probationers |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| A (A1 & A2) | CXO | 90 Days | 15 days |
| B (B1 & B2) | SeniorManagement | 90 Days | 15 days |
| C (C1, C2 & C3) | Middle Management | 60 Days | 15 days |
| D (D1, D2 & D3) | Junior Management | 30 Days | 15 days |
| E (E1, E2 & E3) | Fellow | 30 Days | 15 days |

## Page 5

3.2. Points to Remember
● Holiday or Leave during Notice Period: Employees may request leave during the notice period as an exception with prior approval from their reporting manager.
● Rights and Responsibilities During Notice Period: During the notice period, employees are expected to complete offboarding tasks such as transferring knowledge, handing over documents, and completing ongoing work.
● Return of Company Property: Employees must return all Wingify property upon offboarding. Shipping costs will be covered by Wingify through a mutually agreed-upon method.
● Pay in place of Notice Period: In cases of involuntary exits where an employee is released immediately without serving the notice period, payment for the notice period will be made after a discussion with the Manager, HR, and Department Head, with the CEO being informed of the decision.
● Exception: Pay instead of notice will not be granted in cases of dismissal due to misconduct, insubordination, fraud, or other severe reasons warranting penal action as determined by Wingify.
3.3. Deduction from Full & Final Salary
● If the employee retains the laptop and other company assets, their value will be deducted from the Full and Final Salary as per the Asset Management Policy.
● Any outstanding loans or advances the employee takes will be fully adjusted from their Full and Final Salary.
● If investment proofs, as declared on the HR Portal, are not provided during exit, taxes will be deducted accordingly.
● WFH Allowance will be recovered based on the Home Office Allowance Policy if the exit is within a year of joining.
● Recovery will be made for any excess leaves taken beyond the allotted quota.
● If the employee does not serve the full notice period, the company holds the right to recover the amount equivalent to the short notice period.
● Joining Bonus recovery will be as per the terms mentioned in the offer letter.
● EPF (Employee Provident Fund) and VPF (Voluntary Provident Fund) deductions will be made and deposited into the employee's account.
